newsitem.title: TOGO: Mali has $13.7 million loan package for dam, roads.
newsitem.headline: Mali has $13.7 million loan package for dam, roads.

text.p: The West African Development Bank (BOAD) has approved a loan package totalling seven billion CFA francs ($13.7 million) for agriculture and transport infrastructure for Mali, a bank statement said on Tuesday.
The first of the two loans signed at the bank's headquarters in Lome, Togo, on Monday is for two billion CFA to finance Mali's Ke-Macina irrigation dam to boost rice production.
The second is for five billion CFA and will help fund urban roads improvements in the capital Mali and its sub-ubarn area.
BOAD, which serves seven French-speaking states grouped in the UEMOA monetary union, said the loan package brought its total financial commitments in Mali to 36.2 billion CFA.
